issues: Pre-existing dev-only hydration warning: <span> inside <option> caused by editor-injected data-ve-dynamic wrappers. Not caused by this iteration (carry-over from iter19-21).

critical_code_review_comments: Home.js line 18: PLACEHOLDERS array contains only 1 entry — the typewriter animation loops on a single phrase, which is fine but the animation state machine could be simplified if only one phrase is intended.

Home.js line 84: When searchQuery is non-empty, placeholder becomes empty string. Fine, but consider using aria-label='Search' for accessibility since the visible label is a small (11px) muted text that screen readers may deprioritize.
Copy accessibility: hero h1 uses <br class='hidden sm:inline' /> — this hides the break on mobile as intended. Good implementation.
Pre-existing: Home.js past-papers finder still emits <span>-inside-<option> hydration warning from editor-injected wrappers.
